text:
Sara: Heads-up 1010 need to lock the rollout strategy for the regional routing change. Main asks: shadow/dark-launch, staged canaries, A/B quality gating, and a single panic-button. Who picks up which item?

Tariq: I'll take the feature-flag engineering and the panic endpoint. Proposed flag id: `regional-route-next`. Will push flag config to flagstore and Console.

Ben: Canary plan suggestion: 30m dark-launch (shadow only), then 2% NA for 30m, 10% NA+EU for 2h, 25% global for 6h. Auto-escalate only if all gates pass.

Anya: For enterprise/Dedicated fleets: add an explicit customer holdback list and require CSM opt-in for any of the top 50 accounts. Also add a customer preflight notification email.

Sara: Proposed launch gates (please review):
- p99 latency change <= 20ms absolute
- total error rate delta <= 0.04% absolute
- token cost change <= 6%
- eval-suite MRT drop <= 0.4

Kelly: I'll run A/B eval on a seeded set (1k queries) during the canary windows. If MRT drops > 0.4 or semantic drift > 0.55 we abort. I'll post the raw diff output.

Tariq: Flag example (ops YAML):
```yaml
flag: regional-route-next
phases:
  - mode: dark
    pct: 0
    shadow: true
    duration: 1800
  - pct: 2
    regions: [NA]
    duration: 1800
  - pct: 10
    regions: [NA,EU]
    duration: 7200
  - pct: 25
    regions: [global]
    duration: 21600
manual_locked_targets: [Dedicated]
kill_endpoint: /ops/flags/regional-route-next/abort
metrics: [p99_latency,error_rate,unit_cost,eval_mrt,semantic_drift]
```

Tariq: Panic button (example):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://ops-api.redwood.internal/flags/regional-route-next/abort" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"reason":"emergency - perf/quality","by":"ops"}'
```

ops-bot: Infra check OK for NA/EU/APAC. Autoscaler headroom=18%. Alert rules created for p95/p99 spikes and error burst.

Ben: Preflight mandatory steps:
- 15m synthetic warmup at 5qps to prime kv/embedding caches
- smoke tests for routing correctness
- run dark-launch logging validation (request IDs, latency tags)

Anya: Also add a 45m shadow + compare step where responses are logged and diffs are computed offline. That should catch content regressions without impacting customers.

Sara: Decision needed: fully automated ramp vs manual approval between phases? I propose automated ramp up while gates are green, but require a human approval to enable Dedicated fleets or to go beyond 25%.

Tariq: Agreed. Auto-increase up to 25% with gates. Manual sign-off required for Dedicated and >25%. I'll add ACLs so only ops/product leads can flip those.

Kelly: Metric thresholds for automated rollback: p99 regression > 30ms OR error rate delta > 0.08% OR semantic_drift > 0.55 OR eval_mrt_drop > 0.4 triggers auto-rollback. We'll also set a noisy-but-informative Slack alert to #eng-oncall.

ops-bot: Automated rollback action configured with the above thresholds. Rollback will set flag state -> disabled and notify oncall + product.

Ben: Support enablement: create canned status replies and a short triage flow for CSMs. I'll draft an internal FAQ.

Anya: Timeline/owners:
- Tariq: push flag + panic endpoint (ETA: tomorrow EOD)
- Kelly: schedule A/B eval and semantic drift checks (ETA: start with dark-launch)
- Ben: preflight scripts + support FAQ (ETA: 48 hours)
- ops-bot/SRE: finalize alerts and dashboard (ETA: today)
- Sara: publish runbook & launch card, pick low-traffic midweek slot (ETA: tomorrow morning)

Tariq: One more note: include a telemetry-only mode so we can route 1% and only collect telemetry (no eval decision) in case we want extended monitoring without risk.

Sara: Good idea 1010 add telemetry-only phase before the 2% canary. Update runbook accordingly.

Kelly: I'll add a lightweight BLEU-style semantic check and a fingerprint diff for frequent prompts.

Ben: OK let's get this staged. Ping me when the preflight scripts are in CI and I'll run them.

Sara: Thanks everyone. I'll consolidate this thread into the rollout card and tag for approvals. If no objections by EOD we'll proceed with the plan next week. :white_check_mark:
